changes.to: Haier's own news pages present HIVA 海娃 as its home-service humanoid (housework, cleaning and companion variants), co-developed with Beijing Robot Era and shown at WRC 2026 doing laundry folding, banana peeling and appliance operation. The maker publishes no spec table: height, mass, DoF, payload, runtime, battery and price stay empty. Media coverage of the 26 Jul 2025 unveiling (IT之家) reports 165 cm, 70 kg, 44 DoF and reach from floor to 2 m, and notes the demos were teleoperated; those figures were not filled.
Haier's HIVA (海娃) home-service humanoid, co-developed with Robot Era, that operates Haier appliances for laundry, cooking and cleaning.
